cards.card_text: Stones set in antimony, foundations of sapphires, pinnacles of rubies, gates of sparkling jewels.
cards.verse_text: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
cards.snippet: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of…

cards.card_text: Then the devil takes Him to the holy city and sets Him on the pinnacle of the temple, and friend, you put me near the edge of a counter and I start SWEATING.
cards.verse_text: Then the devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.
cards.snippet: …devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.

cards.card_text: Round three: the devil takes Jesus to Jerusalem, sets Him on the pinnacle of the temple and dares Him to throw Himself down, if He is the Son of God.
cards.verse_text: Then the devil led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.
cards.snippet: Then the devil led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.
